title: DARCQade
tagline: DARQade: A new arcade where AI-powered games meet meme coins! Create prompt-based games, launch unique memecoins, and level up the fun for devs and players alike. 🚀🎮
description: DARQade is an AI-powered GameFi arcade where players earn, trade, and use memecoins tied to unique AI-generated games. Play-to-earn meets DeFi as AI-driven, prompt-based gameplay evolves dynamically. Compete in skill-based challenges, Earn leaderboards, and own your gaming experience in this decentralized, player-driven ecosystem.  In Short, a no-nonsense, Intuitive platform that essentials serves as the pump.fun moment for gamefi.
how_its_made:
I made this project using Python. I had to write custom methods for interacting with the ERC-20 contracts through their ABI.

DARQade is a fully Decentralized application, There is no central DB for storage. I've used nillion secret vaults for storing the Private keys of the custodial accounts in the users and also the token information. 

The User Wallets and memecoins are primarily created on Base. The Plan is to implement Clanker in our project so that we can enable game developers to spin up their Games with liquidity from the get go. 

The onchAIn Agent is based on CDP's agentkit. I've created custom tools that can be used for the different functionalities.
